title: Samuel’s Birth

questions.question: Who was Hannah’s husband?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:1-2 (ESV): “There was a certain man... whose name was Elkanah... He had two wives. The name of the one was Hannah...”

questions.question: Why was Hannah distressed?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:5-7 (ESV): “...because he loved her, though the Lord had closed her womb. And her rival used to provoke her...”

questions.question: What did Hannah vow if God gave her a son?
options: He would be a Nazarite and serve God
questions.correctAnswer: He would be a Nazarite and serve God
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:11 (ESV): “...then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and no razor shall touch his head.”

questions.question: Who thought Hannah was drunk while she prayed?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:13-14 (ESV): “...Eli took her to be a drunken woman. And Eli said to her, ‘How long will you go on being drunk?’”

questions.question: What was the name of Hannah’s son?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:20 (ESV): “...she called his name Samuel, for she said, ‘I have asked for him from the Lord.’”

questions.question: Where did Elkanah go yearly to worship?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:3 (ESV): "Now this man used to go up year by year from his city to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of hosts at Shiloh..."

questions.question: Who were the two sons of Eli serving as priests at Shiloh?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:3 (ESV): "...The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas were priests of the LORD there."

questions.question: How did Elkanah try to comfort Hannah?
options: Am I not better to you than ten sons?
questions.correctAnswer: Am I not better to you than ten sons?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:8 (ESV): "...Hannah, why do you weep? ...Am I not more to you than ten sons?"

questions.question: After weaning Samuel, what did Hannah bring with him to the house of the Lord?
options: A three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine
questions.correctAnswer: A three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:24 (ESV): "And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine..."

questions.question: What did Hannah say to Eli when she brought Samuel?
options: For this child I prayed, and the Lord has granted me my petition
questions.correctAnswer: For this child I prayed, and the Lord has granted me my petition
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:27 (ESV): "For this child I prayed, and the LORD has granted me my petition that I made to him."

questions.question: What was the name of Elkanah's other wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:2 (ESV): "...The name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other, Peninnah."

questions.question: Elkanah was from the hill country of ______?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:1 (ESV): "There was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim of the hill country of Ephraim..."

questions.question: Where did Hannah and Elkanah live?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:19 (ESV): "They rose early in the morning and worshiped before the LORD; then they went back to their house at Ramah..."

questions.question: How long did Hannah stay at home before bringing Samuel to Shiloh?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:22 (ESV): "But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, 'As soon as the child is weaned, I will bring him...'"

questions.question: What phrase describes the Lord's improved favor towards Hannah?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:19 (ESV): "...Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and the LORD remembered her."

key_verse_text: For this child I prayed, and the LORD has granted me my petition that I made to him. (ESV)
